lines.trans: Wait, Viktor Stepanovich, don't do it!
I raised you to such great heights!

lines.trans: And do you think this is easy for me?
I am a kind person, I love animals.
I even genuinely like you, Arkasha.
My heart is literally bleeding right now.
I will not be able to sleep tonight.
Well, no matter, I will build a church later.
I swear, I will not tell anyone anything!
Take off his warm felt boots quickly.

lines.trans: Don't tear my soul, Arkasha, stop it!
Don't, please, spare my life!

I will haunt your dreams every night!

present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?
Take off his warm felt boots.
In winter, felt boots are very comfortable.

examples.text: Снимайте скорее с него тёплые валенки.
examples.trans: Take off his warm felt boots quickly.

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'water' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: Vanya, the water! There's water everywhere!

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

examples.text: Я поднял вас на такую высоту!
examples.trans: I raised you to such heights!
The plane reached the required altitude.

examples.text: Я вас на такую высоту поднял!
examples.trans: I raised you to such great heights!

examples.text: Ты мне даже глубоко симпатичен, Аркаша.
examples.trans: I even genuinely like you, Arkasha.

meanings.note: + infinitive: давай убирать = let's clean up

related.gloss: to give (the verb it comes from)

meanings.note: Core Russian part meaning 'even' in everyday speech.
in greetings: добрый день, добрый вечер

examples.text: Добрый вечер, Вика. С Новым годом!
examples.trans: Good evening, Vika. Happy New Year!

meanings.note: думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.
Why are you hovering over me?

examples.text: У меня на душе сильная тревога.
examples.trans: I have a strong anxiety in my soul.

examples.text: Я добрый человек, я люблю животных.
examples.trans: I am a kind person, I love animals.

examples.text: Аркаш, мне москвичи звонят каждый день. Может, всё-таки передумаем?
examples.trans: Arkasha, the people from Moscow call me every day. Maybe we should reconsider after all?
What is this? Is this blood?
Look how much blood came out!
It's easy for you to say.

examples.text: Да это легко. Схватил собачку в парке и побежал.
examples.trans: Come on, it's easy. Grab the little dog in the park and run.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to love, to like', paired with 'полюбить'.

examples.trans: I love our town very much.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
needs 'не' with the verb: никто не войдёт

examples.trans: I know the town like nobody else.

examples.text: Садитесь и держите дверь. Никто не войдёт.
examples.trans: Sit down and hold the door. Nobody will come in.

meanings.note: usually in the genitive ничего, with не: ничего не осталось

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

meanings.note: ночью = at night; спокойной ночи = good night

examples.text: Ну что, Аркаша? Наступила ночь, просыпается мафия.
examples.trans: So, Arkasha? Night has fallen, the mafia wakes up.

meanings.note: hesitation, at the start of a sentence

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

examples.text: Он обливается холодной водой по утрам.
examples.trans: He pours cold water over himself in the mornings.

examples.text: У меня прямо сердце кровью обливается.
examples.trans: My heart is literally bleeding right now.

meanings.note: accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.trans: Lower him straight into the water.
He puts his hands into his pockets.

examples.text: Давай, опускайте его прямо в воду!
examples.trans: Go on, lower him straight into the water!

meanings.note: перестань(те)! = stop it!, oh come on!

examples.text: Да перестаньте! Я двадцать лет в карты не играла.
examples.trans: Oh, stop it! I haven't played cards for twenty years.

examples.text: Иначе я перестану давать тебе деньги!
examples.trans: Otherwise I'll stop giving you money!

поднять.gloss: to lift, to raise; to rouse

examples.text: А я глаза на это закрывать не буду. Я подниму людей!
examples.trans: Well, I'm not going to close my eyes to this. I'll rally people!
They want to build a shopping centre there.

meanings.note: Core Russian adv meaning 'then, later, afterwards' in everyday speech.

meanings.en: to spare one's life, show mercy

examples.trans: The judge decided to spare the defendant.

examples.text: В смысле, Виктор Степанович? Прямо так, да?
examples.trans: What do you mean, Viktor Stepanovich? Just like that?

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

meanings.note: у меня сердце = I have a bad heart (colloquial)

examples.text: Мне горько, мне плохо. У меня сердце.
examples.trans: I feel bitter, I feel awful. I have a bad heart.

meanings.en: likeable, appealing (short form: он мне симпатичен = I like him / I find him likeable)
meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'импатичный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('likeable, nice; cute').

examples.trans: I like him, he's a decent guy.

examples.text: Он мне симпатичен, нормальный мужик. Ладно, тогда давайте сами.
examples.trans: I like him, he's a decent guy. Fine, then come up with something yourselves.

meanings.note: once; что скажешь? = what do you say?

examples.trans: Tell us, when will your programme be out?

meanings.note: comparative of скоро used as adverb or particle

examples.trans: Let's go quickly to the studio!

снимать.gloss: to take off; to film; to rent

examples.trans: Watch. I'm taking off my ring.

сниться.gloss: to appear in a dream, to be dreamed

meanings.note: + dative: мне снится = I dream of / I am having a dream

examples.trans: What did you dream about tonight?

examples.text: И так всю ночь! Ему снятся страшные сны.
examples.trans: It's been like that all night! He's having terrible dreams.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'пать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to sleep', paired with 'поспать'.

examples.text: Ладно, утром позвоню ей. Поехали спать.
examples.trans: All right, I'll call her in the morning. Let's go to sleep.

meanings.note: the infinitive 'Стоять!' as a police order
the infinitive 'Стоять!' as a police order

examples.text: То есть просто стоять и смотреть?
examples.trans: So we just stand and watch?

meanings.note: 'что я за мэр такой' = what kind of mayor am I

examples.text: Теперь я начальник нашей стройки. Ты уволен!
examples.trans: Now I'm the boss of our building site. You're fired!

examples.text: Не трави мне душу этими словами.
examples.trans: Do not distress my soul with those words.

examples.text: Не трави мне душу, Аркаша, перестань!
examples.trans: Don't tear my soul, Arkasha, stop it!

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.trans: And where are your warm gloves?

examples.trans: Yes, his warm hat is lying right here.

examples.text: Снимайте скорее с него тёплые валенки.
examples.trans: Take off his warm felt boots quickly.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'temple, cathedral' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: And for insurance, a Buddhist temple too!

examples.text: На вершине холма стоит древний храм.
examples.trans: An ancient temple stands atop the hill.

examples.text: Ну ничего, я потом построю храм.
examples.trans: Well, no matter, I will build a church later.

meanings.note: the plural is a different word: люди, людям, о людях

examples.trans: There are a lot of people here.
I know the problems of ordinary people.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
